title: State hardship percentages and estimated adults · Cycle 9
caption: We sort states to make comparison easier, not to establish a statistical ranking. Overlapping intervals do not test whether estimates are equal or different. Each state also contributes respondents to the U.S. estimate. Overall state cells pass the project rule. All 459 cells and their missingness are in state_hardship_by_cycle.csv. We would need replicate population totals to estimate count intervals; scaling percentage intervals is not enough. These counts estimate adults, not households, clients, or service demand. We exclude missing HPS answers separately for each outcome. The tables for all cycles show valid counts, Kish effective sample sizes, missing counts, and suppression flags.
